name: Elasticsearch cross-cluster API key
description: An Elasticsearch API key of the cross-cluster type that allows another cluster to connect for cross-cluster search and replication.

blockers.summary: Elastic defines the encoded value identically to a user API key's and states no string property that marks the cross_cluster type.
Base64 alphabet, padding and part lengths would need an issued key, which is not created here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
